description: Honen Dalim in Oranjestad on Sint Eustatius is the synagogue built in 1739 of yellow brick brought as ballast. The roof has been gone since the 1792 hurricane and was not put back. The 2001 work stabilised the walls and did not rebuild a roof. It is clear, about 29.0°C, with wind near 21.7 km/h and no cloud. A mikvah stair sits to the side. No plaque text is readable. Fort Oranje and the Dutch Reformed Church are other scenes.
